articles.title: 2024 Data Release New and Notable - Census.gov
articles.content: The New and Notable page highlights important information supporting each of the data releases. You can also visit the User Notes and Errata Notes pages to learn about issues, errors, andor corrections impacting the survey. Related Information 2024 ACS 1-year estimates are based on data collected from January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2024. 2024 ACS 1-year estimates are available in data.census.gov and the API. The Census Bureau recommends using Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge when accessing data.census.gov. Learn more about data.census.gov resources, including how-to materials, video tutorials, and more. 2024 ACS 1-year estimates are available for geographic areas with populations of 65,000 or more. View the recorded webinar highlighting important changes for the 2024 ACS 1-year release and tips for comparing geographies and statistics over time. Guidance on comparing the 2024 ACS 1-year estimates with 2023 ACS 1-year estimates, 2020 Census, and 2010 Census by subject area is now available. The 1-year Summary File data on the FTP site are now available. Supporting materials were released on September 4, 2025. Visit 2024 Table and Geography Changes for a list and description of new, modified and deleted tables, as well as information on changes to geography. The Areas Published, Geography Boundaries by Year, and Reference Materials pages have been updated for 2024. Table shells for the 2024 ACS 1-year tables and profiles are available on the FTP site. The 2024 ACS Table List is also available. It includes information, such as table IDs, titles, and universes, as well as 1-year5-year availability, in one spreadsheet. Supporting documentation has been released to help users prepare for the release of the 2024 ACS 1-year estimates. Additional technical documentation will be released on September 11, 2025. Supporting documentation for the 2024 ACS 1-year Summary File has been released. The 1-year Summary File on the FTP site will be available on release day. For more information, visit the ACS Summary File page. The 2024 American Community Survey (ACS) 1-year estimates are scheduled to be released on September 11, 2025. These data will be available for the nation, all states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, every congressional district, every metropolitan area, and all counties and places with populations of 65,000 or more. The 2024 ACS 1-year Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) files and 2024 ACS 1-year Supplemental Estimates are scheduled to be released on October 16, 2025. For more information on the release schedule, visit the 2024 ACS Release Schedule. The 2020-2024 ACS 5-year estimates are scheduled to be released on December 11, 2025. These data will be available for all geographic areas including census tracts, ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs), and block groups. The 2020-2024 ACS 5-year Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) files and 2020-2024 ACS 5-year Variance Replicate Estimates are scheduled to be released on January 22, 2026. For more information on the release schedule, visit the 2024 ACS Release Schedule.
